facts.fact: from_fd performs handshake then returns; it starts no receiver loops.
run owns private Vec<JoinHandle>; spawn uses ?, so partial creation can return while earlier loops remain detached.
Normal iteration joins every handle; first join panic returns early and drops remaining handles. Err alone does not identify whether every loop joined.
SessionEventLoop is crate-private and event_loop is private. No public loop-entry/loop-exit notification surrounds its receive loop.
BackgroundSession exposes only the outer run thread handle.

nix_pidfd_hits.text: /// Return the pidfd of the foreign process connected to this socket.

nix_conclusion: No pidfd_open/thread-pidfd safe wrapper found in pinned nix 0.31.3; socket peer process/fanotify pidfd support is not an owned receiver-loop lifecycle interface.
limits: Source inspection establishes missing public interfaces. It is not a native liveness/failure test, a proof about all conceivable OS techniques, or a runtime prerequisite waiver.
